groups.name: DEADLOCK
groups.profile: First seen Jun 2026 (115 claimed victims on Ransomware.live). A steady mid-volume group focused on manufacturing and professional services. Three of today's records have a country field that conflicts with the victim's own description.

groups.name: LOCKBIT5
groups.profile: First seen Dec 2025 as the LockBit 5.0 leak site (398 claimed victims). LockBit-branded sites have a documented history of recycled and inflated claims.

groups.name: INC RANSOM
groups.profile: RaaS active since Aug 2023 (991 claimed victims). Prolific, with heavy US healthcare and professional-services targeting. Commonly reported initial access is via exposed edge devices and stolen credentials. Today's three posts were logged by Ransomware.live only.

groups.name: MAJINAHANASHI
groups.profile: First seen Aug 2026 (30 claimed victims). A small group whose posts often carry no country attribution. Today's three were RansomLook-only; this is its first activity since 31 Oct.

groups.name: AKIRA
groups.profile: Active since Mar–Apr 2023 (1,675 claimed victims) and one of the most prolific current operations. It is widely reported to gain access through compromised VPN appliances.

groups.name: BARRACUDA
groups.profile: First seen Aug 2026 (17 claimed victims). Low volume with a broad spread of targets.

groups.name: CLOAK
groups.profile: Established group active since Aug 2023 (168 claimed victims). Today's post ends a three-week quiet spell (last Ransomware.live-indexed posting 18 Oct).

groups.name: ECLIPSE
groups.profile: First seen Aug 2026 (22 claimed victims). Concentrated on Singapore and India; transportation is its top sector.

groups.name: OROVA
groups.profile: First seen Aug 2026 (64 claimed victims). Leans toward US and East-Asian targets (HK, TW, SG).

groups.name: WHITEARMOR
groups.profile: Treat its claims with caution until data samples appear.
